images.alt: Scatter plot of 1,903 men's marathon results below 2:08 from 1985 to 2025, highlighting performances by Gebrselassie, Kipsang, Kipchoge, Bekele, and Kiptum
Scatter plot of elite men's marathon results with arrows tracing official world records from Carlos Lopes in 1985 to Kelvin Kiptum in 2023 and marking Geoffrey Mutai's ineligible Boston time
Scatter plot of 1,903 men's marathon times below 2:08 against athlete age from 18 to 42, with the fastest results spread mainly across the mid-twenties through late thirties
Histogram of men's sub-2:08 marathon results by age with a cumulative percentage line, peaking at age 26 and reaching 80 percent across ages 23 through 33
